page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8ise.3xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance configured with 12 dedicated vCPUs and 48.0 GB of system memory. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8475B processor operating at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz, this instance utilizes the x86_64 CPU architecture and runs on the KVM hypervisor. The resource allocation provides a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core, making it suitable for standard enterprise applications.

This instance does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via attached network volumes. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Lacking dedicated GPUs, the instance is designed for standard CPU-bound workloads. It is suitable for general-purpose applications, middle-tier web servers, enterprise application hosting, and moderate database workloads that do not require local high-speed storage or specialized hardware acceleration.
